description: Explicit win condition specification. All conditions must hold simultaneously for the 'win' predicate to be true.

win_conditions.description: glyph_key_id in game state must equal (glyph_width // 8) % 16 for the scenario's glyph_index. A glyph_key with a wrong id does not satisfy the win condition.
ALL three colour keys must be in inventory: key_red AND key_green AND key_blue (see instruction §9).

note: The exit action (R5->R7) also enforces these conditions before granting entry to R7. Winning by entering R7 through any other means is not possible — R7 has no other door.
